Class CallbackContext

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.agents.ReadonlyContext
com.google.adk.agents.Context
com.google.adk.agents.CallbackContext
Direct Known Subclasses:
ToolContext
public class CallbackContext extends Context
The context of various callbacks for an agent invocation.

Extends Context for backward compatibility; agent and model callback signatures still use this type.
